standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Hey I'm Amy, how may I help you?
I'm the founder of Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first Construction company!
We've currently got branches in Falador, Varrock, Hosidius and Ardougne.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: So people contact you for help with their homes?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Yep! They'll get in contact if they want assistance, whether it's fixing parts of their house or requesting nicer furniture, and then we will go and help them out.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: That sounds quite enjoyable and satisfying to do, are you hiring at all?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: If you have the supplies, I can tell you where one of our clients is that needs some work doing.
I'll keep track of the work you do as well and give you some points for our company reward shop.
Also there are assistants in Varrock, Ardougne, and Hosidius that can give you work, if Falador is inconvienent for you.
The clients that I would offer you to go help could be in any of those cities, it might be a bit of a journey to get there!

steps.npc: What kind of contract would you like?

steps.player: Could I have a beginner contract please?

steps.npc: Please could you go see [client] [area] [city], [location description] for us? You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.

standard-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Hey I'm Amy, how may I help you?

options.condition: If the player currently has a construction contract:

steps.npc: Go see [client] [area] [city], [location description]. You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.

options.condition: If the player does not currently have a construction contract:

options.text: Could I see the reward shop?

steps.npc: Pretty good, we've only opened up recently and already have 12 clients!
These clients are quite indecisive about what they want their houses to look like though, I'm not complaining.

steps.text: If the player has completed at least one contract:

steps.player: Yeah I've noticed that they seem to keep breaking hatstands all the time too, I'm not sure how easy it is to break a hatstand...

options.text: Why don't you have a construction cape?
options.condition: If the player is wearing a construction cape:

steps.player: Why don't you have a construction cape if you're a master builder?

steps.npc: Well why do you have one?

steps.player: The teleports on it are really handy.

steps.npc: Why would a cape for construction use magic? That seems a bit illogical doesn't it?
We are people of hard work, not ones that rely on wizardry!
